scope: Unbounded relevant forbidden-fact and visibility sets. A no-visible-forbidden-fact decision needs complete relevant visibility; fixed facts alone do not stabilize it. Plain-profile admission excludes both native RLS flags regardless of current administrative visibility.
limitations: No SQL policy, role/BYPASSRLS/config/ACL visibility refinement or whole-source lifetime proof
Native metadata refusal is an installed fixture control; no full RLS-aware provider qualification
Does not prove all policy predicates, authenticated issuer/caller, protected evaluation or final disclosure
